title: Preserve replacement lock on original owner's exit and test lock ownership
instructions: C QUALITY ONLY. On exact public base_sha, in part2/capital_flow/storage.py ArchiveWriterLock.__exit__, the current code closes self.fd then unconditionally unlinks lock_path by pathname. This can delete another owner's replacement lock if the original lock pathname was moved/replaced while the original context remained active. Implement a narrowly scoped fail-closed owner-identity guard: before closing the owned fd, capture its os.fstat identity (st_dev, st_ino); close it; unlink the pathname only if current lock_path.lstat() still matches that captured identity. If the pathname is absent, replaced, or stat fails, never unlink it. Preserve normal successful lock release and existing __enter__ PID-write failure cleanup. Do not auto-reap orphan locks, trust PID alone, or modify archive data. In part2/capital_flow/tests/test_archive_concurrent_dedup.py add a deterministic tmp_path no-network regression: enter original lock; rename original .lock to a test-owned backup; create distinct replacement .lock with sentinel text/inode; exit original lock; assert replacement sentinel and identity remain; clean only test-owned paths in finally. Also assert ordinary lock release allows immediate reacquire. Preserve existing clean ENOSPC, preexisting sentinel fail-closed, child crash exitcode 17 and concurrent reader/writer tests unchanged. Run git diff --check, targeted tests and full Capital Flow suite; commit only on PASS. Never touch automation/**, .github/**, private, main, secrets, prediction/API orchestration/journals/Telegram/MT5/broker/execution, or Railway. No broad refactor; do not enqueue another task.
